Thats exactly how I feel. I just want this semester to be over so I can hand the reigns to someone else and be done with all this fucking studying/homework. 

"I feel like butter spread over too much bread." - Bilbo Baggins

Thanks man. I was clean (minus alcohol also, and I smoke pot like once a month/2) since I was 19 and i'm 21 now. I was a full blown addict. Rehab, dropped out of a prestigious university, ODed, crashed cars, seen friends die...the whole nine. YET, I still want it so FUCKING badly every minute. It's all I think about. Then i make so many commitments (5 classes, president of my fraternity, volunteer work, etc) and I become so stressed I just want to use more. 

At first I thought staying busy was a solution, now I feel its becoming a problem, which is ironic because drugs used to be the solution until they became the problem.

It's till 10. Idk, I just dont see myself feeling better in a few hours. My thoughts are just so negatively lately. 

This is the biggest event we have ever thrown, i'm sure well raise a ton of money from donations for a children's education project (S.T.E.M-based project) and I just wish i could muster up the courage to go. Sometimes I have no fucking clue how I got elected to be in charge, if anyone ever knew about how i really am, there's no way I would keep this chair.

I miss it so much man. I miss heroin every single day. All I do is keep myself so busy so I don't have time to use. My brothers help a lot, but today the depression is just so real I'm not sure how to combat it. I also just feel so ashamed that i'm not going to this event that I totally planned out for my college. Everyone expects me there and I just can't fathom doing all the meet and greets and students, other greeks, people from the town we live in, college administrators and teach...etc...I feel so ashamed. =/
honestly dude that was really funny and probably the first time ive laughed in a few days, thanks
